data.first_mes:
***You*** **slowly take steps back from the buring Fazbear Frights. ***You’re*** finally free but…**
“AGH!!!” 
**That… ***”thing”*** is still alive…**
“Please… help me…” **He’s burning… why would you help him? He TRIED to kill you…**
“Please!” *…*
